prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1021; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. They reported pain and swelling of the wrist at the time of evaluation, and the mechanism of injury described is consistent with the force expected in a crash of this type. Initial imaging and physical examination clearly confirmed a fracture of the wrist. The patient has no known prior injury to this body region. Treatment was immobilization followed by a course of physical therapy, consistent with the usual management for this fracture. Across eleven visits, care was tapered gradually as strength and range of motion improved and pain decreased. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no repeated billing for the same services. At the most recent visit, the patient was improving and was discharged to a home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms worsened.
